requiredCases.name: TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > AC-C34-01 a running ladder’s rounds are its ordered live check-off on the real /workout route: a tap selects the prefix through it, the count says how many, no rung tile carries a check glyph, by touch and keyboard

TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > AC-R013-01 selecting a completed rung selects its preceding prefix and partial work belongs to the next rung: one contiguous run, never a gap, live and in the log, recorded as highest_rung alone

TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > AC-C36-01 checked live progress is imported at Finish into the editable log: every round checked starts Complete, a prefix Incomplete through its last round, and the athlete corrects either before the save

TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > AC-R013-03 Finish alone never selects every rung and planned targets never become actuals: nothing tracked starts Incomplete with no round stated and records nothing; the cap imports what was checked

TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > AC-C33-01 the result tiles are rep-first and level: the rep target largest, the round secondary, the unit its own row, wrapping without a glyph for twelve and four rungs, one digit and two (AC-R013-02)

TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > JOURNEY-013 recovery: checked progress, the pause and the edited log survive close and reopen from the ladder’s durable record; effort stays unsaved; a saved ladder claims no answer

TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > JOURNEY-013 a ladder with no cap, a ladder clock an older build stored and a schedule: one durable attempt each, the progress imported only at Finish, and a schedule’s rounds stated by the athlete
